newsitem.title: USA: Universal Hospital Q4 includes writeoff.
newsitem.headline: Universal Hospital Q4 includes writeoff.

text.p: Universal Hospital Services Inc attributed its fourth-quarter loss to a pretax charge of $1.2 million to write off the remaining carrying value of devices related to its exit from the sleep apnea market.
The company cited continuing declining sales of demand positive air pressure (DPAP) devices.
For the fourth quarter, it incurred a loss of $492,317 or $0.09 per share compared to year-ago profit of $673,901 or $0.12 per share.
Universal Hospital's fourth-quarter revenues, $15.2 million compared to $13.6 million, included revenues from Biomedical Equipment Rental & Sales Inc, which was acquired last August.
